meta.title: GEO health check
meta.description: Scores how ready a DSH plugin repository is for generative search engines: parses docs, metadata and source into a fact graph, reports weighted deductions with file and line anchors, generates llms.txt / ai.txt / JSON-LD that must match the visible text, and keeps a local, offline history of runs.

tools.audit: Audit crawlability for international and domestic AI engines
tools.monitor: Record or read visibility monitoring history
